high_level_description: The image shows a collection of decorative tiles with intricate patterns. The tiles are primarily blue with vibrant yellow and green accents. Each tile features a central floral design with a symmetrical arrangement of flowers and leaves. The flowers have a mix of blue and yellow petals, with some having a darker blue center. The leaves are depicted in various shades of green, adding to the complexity of the design. The tiles are arranged in a slightly overlapping manner, creating a sense of depth and texture.
